_note: Every figure the documents quote, tied to the artefact it comes from.
`key` names an entry in outputs/evidence.json, written by
scripts/evidence.py. `value` is what that entry must equal. `quoted` is
the exact string that has to appear in each file listed under `docs`.
So there are two ways to fail and they mean different things. If the
artefact no longer yields `value`, the project has moved and the
documents are stale. If `quoted` is not in the document, somebody has
edited a number in the text without touching what produced it - which is
the failure this file exists for, and the one nothing else would catch.
Figures that are not in this file are not checked. That is a real gap
and a smaller one than it looks: what belongs here is every number a
reader could act on, not every number that appears.
Entries whose `key` is null are quoted from a source outside this
repository - a rulebook article, a row count in a file that is not
committed - and are checked only for being present in the text. The
`source` field says where to go and look.
